spans.s: Bhāna- (Index), or Bhāma- (text) -kanakamuni, Mv 〔i.294.20〕, appears to be another designation of Kanakamuni, q.v., unless the text is corrupt, which is probable.
Bhānuprabhā, n. of a śreṣṭhinʼs daughter: Gv 〔427.20〕.
bhānuvant, adj. (= Skt., Pali bhānumant), shining: LV 〔357.9〕, see s.v. ūrṇākośa.
